About Gifted Eternity Streaming Services

Gifted Eternity is a streaming service that provides access to a wide range of content, including movies, TV shows, and original content.

  • Provides access to a wide range of content
  • Offers a user-friendly interface
  • Supports multiple devices and platforms

Installation and Usage

To install and use Gifted Eternity, follow these steps:

  1. Clone the repository using git clone https://github.com/damoneward38/giftedeternitystreaming.git
  2. Install the dependencies using npm install or pnpm install
  3. Start the application using npm start or pnpm start

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, Next.js, Vite
  • Backend: Node.js, Express
  • Database: MySQL, Redis
  • Deployment: AWS, Google Cloud
